name: Tempeh over Spicy Egg Fried Rice with Snap Peas, Carrots & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
3 (8 oz) pkgs sugar snap peas
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a large bowl.
Halve snap peas. Add to the bowl with the carrots.
Peel and mince ginger. Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices, then stir-fry until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs in a medium bowl and whisk to combine.

When the veggies are done, add egg to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, until set and no longer runny, 1-2 minutes. Transfer veggies and egg to the reserved large bowl; loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) packages tempeh
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the rice is resting, wipe the pot clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tempeh in a single layer and cook, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve pot for the next step.)

When the rice is done, transfer to the pot along with veggie-egg mixture, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce. Return pot to medium-high heat and stir-fry until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Divide fried rice between plates or bowls; top with tempeh and reserved cilantro. Serve with additional chili-garlic sauce on the side and enjoy!
